intro: Lesson 8: Sawm: what fasting is and why we fast. To understand what sawm is and why Allah made fasting in Ramadan a pillar of Islam

passage.title: al-Baqarah 2:183
paras: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.

questions.q: Explain what sawm is in one sentence.
questions.a: Sawm is not eating or drinking from dawn until sunset in Ramadan, for Allah.
questions.model: Sawm means fasting: from Fajr to Maghrib I do not eat or drink, and I keep my words good, for the sake of Allah.

questions.a: To obey Allah and gain taqwa; to feel for the hungry

questions.q: Make a 'Why we fast' poster with four reasons, one with the ayah 2:183.
questions.a: Obey Allah; taqwa (2:183); empathy for the hungry; forgiveness and reward.
questions.model: Teacher writes the first reason: 'Allah commanded it: fasting was decreed upon us (2:183).'

questions.a: Being aware of Allah and careful to obey Him.

questions.q: how can fasting help control anger?
questions.a: It trains self-control; the fasting person avoids arguing.

questions.q: Fasting is in the month of ...
Back to our ponder: what do we gain by fasting?
questions.a: Taqwa, reward, self-control and care for the hungry.
